answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in proof-of-work tied to real resources: each agent identity must burn a verifiable amount of timber biomass processing, recorded as a signed receipt. An attacker forging ten thousand identities must purchase and consume ten thousand times the fuel, pushing their cost curve to a nadir where the attack loses money. Even a single ember of collusion is detectable because receipts chain to physical delivery logs, letting peers audit supply and reject duplicate identities cheaply.
